artworks.title: The Calydonian Boar Hunt (Meleager Sarcophagus)
artworks.description: Capitoline sarcophagus: the boar Artemis sent against Calydon rears amid the heroes, Meleager poised for the killing thrust — the hunt as Roman funerary courage.

artworks.title: Atalanta and Meleager Hunt the Calydonian Boar
artworks.description: Flemish Baroque hunt: Atalanta among the heroes as the bristling boar and straining hounds fill the canvas — first blood and the prize that will ruin a house.

artworks.title: Meleager and Atalanta
artworks.description: Jordaens stages the aftermath: Meleager awards the hide to Atalanta — the gesture of love that enrages his uncles and burns the brand of his fate.

artworks.title: Meleager and Atalanta (wall painting from Pompeii)
artworks.description: Pompeian fresco: Meleager and Atalanta in the quiet after the hunt — the charged regard that Ovid makes the seed of Calydon's family quarrel.

popCulture.title: Calydonian boar
popCulture.description: The great hunt endures as myth's archetype of the disastrous prize — Atalanta's hide, Meleager's brand, and a house destroyed by a trophy.
